title: How many dollars is the discount?
text: $$20\%$$ of the price is the amount removed, not 20 dollars. A common mistake is to answer $$40 - 20 = 20$$. What is $$0.20 \times 40$$?

title: Subtract the discount from the original price
text: The sale price is $$40 - 8$$. What is that difference?

title: Worked solution
text: The discount is $$0.20 \times 40 = 8$$ dollars, so the sale price is $$40 - 8 = 32$$ dollars. Equivalently, you pay $$80\%$$ of the price: $$0.80 \times 40 = 32$$. Common mistake: subtracting 20 from 40. General rule: percent off means subtract (percent as a decimal) times the original price.
